waves.title: Wave 00 — Foundation: frozen contracts, schema v1, platform skeletons, stubs & compose
waves.goal: Freeze every shared contract (all @insta/contracts DTOs + SSE events, 0001_init.sql, domain ports/entity types/service signatures, row types), build the API platform, web platform, design system and infra, and pre-create stub files for every module so that downstream feature waves only edit their own module files.

tasks.title: Freeze workspace, contracts, schema v1, domain ports and module stubs
tasks.objective: Create npm workspaces (root package.json scripts per infra/02, tsconfig.base.json, apps/api + apps/web + packages/contracts package/tsconfig files, vite.config.ts, index.html). Implement the complete @insta/contracts package (ids, errors, pagination, limits, every dto/*.ts, events.ts). Write apps/api/migrations/0001_init.sql with every table, constraint and index from persistence/01 + 02. Freeze apps/api/src/domain: shared (branded IDs, DomainError + ErrorCode copy, Clock, IdGenerator, Page/TimeCursor, UnitOfWork/Tx/EventCollector/DomainEventPublisher ports, DomainEvent union) and, for every module (identity, media, posts, social, stories, notifications, feed, search), ports.ts, entity/read-model type declarations and service classes with frozen constructors and method signatures whose bodies throw NOT_IMPLEMENTED; include domain/identity/session-authenticator.ts stub. Create every data/rows/<stem>.row.ts with full row types, stub row mappers and pg repositories (frozen constructors), stub data/security and data/probe adapters, api/routes/index.ts listing all 13 route modules with stub route files, stub api/mappers files, jobs stub files (media-cleanup.job.ts, story-cleanup.job.ts). Web: ui/pages/index.ts exporting all 14 route pages as stubs, stub cross-wave components (posts/PostCard, posts/PostGrid, social/LikeButton, social/FollowButton, social/FollowListModal, social/CommentSection, stories/StoryTray, profile/ProfileHeader) and stub state hooks with frozen signatures (state/auth|profile|posts|feed|comments|social|notifications|live|stories|search.ts). Everything must typecheck. If any spec gap is found, fix docs/specs first and re-run spec validation.

tasks.title: API platform: config, server, errors, auth plugin, DB/UoW/event bus, migrations runner, SSE infra, health, jobs runner
tasks.objective: Implement apps/api/src/main.ts composition root wiring every (stub) repository and service with frozen constructors; config/env.ts (Zod env parsing, exit non-zero listing invalid keys); api/server.ts (Fastify 5, zod type provider, CORS, X-Request-Id, Cache-Control no-store, pino redact, rate limits, 64 KiB body cap, central error handler DomainError/ZodError/404/500, RESPONSE_VALIDATION, registers api/routes/index.ts); api/auth.plugin.ts (bearer -> AuthContext via SessionAuthenticator, required/optional/none); data/db (pool, UnitOfWork with after-commit InProcessEventBus publishing, migrate.ts forward-only runner with advisory lock + checksums); data/storage/local-media-storage.ts; api/sse (SseTicketStore 60s single-use, SseHub per-user connections max 5, heartbeat 25s, closeSession); api/routes/health.routes.ts (/healthz, /api/v1/health) and events.routes.ts (ticket + stream); api/mappers/common.dto-mapper.ts + url-builder.ts (toPublicId/parsePublicId, cursor codec, UserSummaryDto, MediaResponseDto); jobs/index.ts + runner.ts (advisory-locked intervals, JOBS_ENABLED, graceful shutdown). Test helpers (buildTestApp, resetDb, raw-SQL base fixtures) and platform unit/integration tests.

tasks.title: Web platform: app shell, routing & guards, design system, typed API client, session store, runtime config
tasks.objective: Implement apps/web/src/main.tsx and App.tsx (React Router 6 data router route table from ui/pages/index.ts, RequireAuth/PublicOnly guards, per-route error boundary), config.ts (window.__APP_CONFIG__), the complete typed API client in apps/web/src/api (http.ts ApiError + request<T>, one file per module covering every /api/v1 endpoint incl. XHR media upload with progress and events ticket), state/session.ts (localStorage insta.session, useSyncExternalStore, storage-event logout sync), state/query-client.ts (401 -> clear session + redirect, 429 toast), state/form-errors.ts (mapApiErrorToFormErrors), state/theme.ts, state/mappers/common.ts (toUserSummaryVM, toMediaVM, compact number + relative time formatters), ui/layout (AppShell desktop sidebar + mobile top/bottom bars, toast region, mounts useLiveEvents stub and unread badge stub), ui/components/primitives (Button, Avatar with ring, TextField, TextArea, Modal, Sheet, Toast, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, VideoPlayer, MediaCarousel, Spinner), styles/tokens.css + global.css, NotFoundPage, apps/web/nginx (default.conf.template, 30-runtime-config.sh). Unit tests for mappers, session store and guards.

tasks.title: Infra & tooling: Dockerfiles, compose stack, env catalog, CI skeleton, ESLint layer rules
tasks.objective: Write apps/api/Dockerfile and apps/web/Dockerfile exactly per infra/01 (non-root, multi-stage), docker-compose.yml (db internal-only, api + web health-checked, WEB_HOST_PORT/API_HOST_PORT, named volumes, internal/edge networks), docker-compose.dev.yml (db on DB_HOST_PORT), .dockerignore, .env.example with every variable from infra/02 (placeholder POSTGRES_PASSWORD), eslint.config.js with import/no-restricted-paths layer rules (domain must not import api/data/fastify/pg/@insta/contracts; api must not import data; web ui must not import api) plus Prettier config, .github/workflows/ci.yml with steps 1-7 and 9 of infra/02 (spec validation, lint, typecheck, unit, integration with postgres:16 service, build, compose smoke, outbound-HTTP grep gate F-ECOMM-12; Playwright step left as a placeholder job for w06), README quick start.

tasks.title: Validate Wave 00 & author check guide
tasks.objective: Run wave-validate (2-iteration audit/fix loop): npm ci, build, lint, typecheck, unit + integration tests, spec validation, compose up --wait on the w00 port block with /healthz and /api/v1/health green, verify every stub compiles and every frozen signature matches docs/specs. Merge per-task gap notes into docs/questions-and-limitations/w00-gaps.md, write docs/plan/checks/w00-check.md and .yardos/waves/w00/review-packet.json.

waves.title: Wave 01 — Identity, sessions, profiles & media upload
waves.goal: Sign up / log in / log out / me / edit profile / public profile, media upload + serving + cleanup job, and the corresponding auth, profile and edit-profile web pages.

Implement the slice every sibling depends on: domain/identity/session.ts (Session entity, expiry), domain/identity/session-authenticator.ts (sha256 lookup of active session -> AuthContext, used by auth.plugin), data/security/token-generator.ts, session.row-mapper.ts + session.pg-repository.ts, domain/media/media-asset.ts (MediaAsset entity, assertAttachable, attach), media.row-mapper.ts + media.pg-repository.ts. Round-trip unit tests for session.row-mapper are written by W01-02 (test/unit/identity) and for media.row-mapper by W01-03 (test/unit/media).

Unit tests (entities, service with fakes, mapper round-trips) and integration tests for every endpoint (happy path + auth failure + validation failure, responses parsed with contracts).

tasks.title: Media backend: upload, sniffing, limits, serving, cleanup job
tasks.objective: Implement domain/media/media.service.ts (sniff first 4100 bytes, stream with size cap, image dimension probe, video duration/dimension bounds, avatar must be image, delete file if insert fails), data/probe (MediaProbe via file-type + image-size), media.routes.ts (POST /api/v1/media multipart with 30/min per-user limit; GET /media/{storage_key} with correct Content-Type and immutable cache headers), media.dto-mapper.ts, jobs/media-cleanup.job.ts (unattached > 24h, batches of 500, remove files). Unit + integration tests (415, 413, video without duration, happy upload + fetch).

tasks.title: Web identity: login, signup, profile, edit profile
tasks.objective: Implement LoginPage, SignupPage (inline VALIDATION_FAILED.details mapping, ?next redirect), ProfilePage (header with avatar story ring linking to /stories/:username, counters, bio, follow button via frozen social/FollowButton stub, edit-profile button for self, PostGrid stub for the grid, followers/following nested routes opening the FollowListModal stub), EditProfilePage (avatar upload purpose avatar, username, full name, bio; only changed fields), ui/components/profile (ProfileHeader, AvatarUploader, ProfileCounters), state/auth.ts (signup/login/logout mutations, logout clears caches), state/profile.ts (me + profile queries, update mutation), state/mappers/auth.ts + profile.ts (toMeVM, toProfileVM, toSignupDto, toLoginDto, toUpdateProfileDto). Unit tests for mappers and form behaviour.

tasks.title: Validate Wave 01 & author check guide
tasks.objective: Run wave-validate (2 iterations): build, lint (layer rules), typecheck, unit, integration against Postgres, compose preview on the w01 port block, manual walkthrough signup -> edit profile with avatar -> logout -> login. Merge per-task gap notes into docs/questions-and-limitations/w01-gaps.md; write docs/plan/checks/w01-check.md and .yardos/waves/w01/review-packet.json.

Unit tests for cursor handling; integration tests incl. pagination stability under inserts and EXPLAIN index assertions for feed/explore.

Unit tests incl. live reconnect/dedupe logic.
